post.description:
RF23 / spec §3.5 Ruling 2 — an occasional route assigned to N workers is N independent
routes, one per worker, each a copy of the same stops. One transaction: if any worker id
is unknown, nothing is committed.

manager endpoints return, so mobile and the dashboard render a route identically. Without
`?date=` it defaults to today; CANCELLED routes are never shown.

RF53 — a manager closes a stop the worker could not reach, with a reason and no
evidence. `complete_manually` owns and commits its own transaction (the execution module
exception to "service flushes, never commits"); the audit trail is appended in a second
transaction afterwards, exactly as `start_route` does.

get.description:
Finding C2: the dashboard's /profissionais screen needs FIELD_WORKER-role Users not yet
linked to a FieldWorker, for its link dropdown. GET /users is Admin-only (RF05), so a
Manager gets 403 there — this router serves its own minimal projection instead. Registered
before any `/{worker_id}`-shaped route so "linkable-users" is never captured as a path
parameter (this router currently has no GET "/{worker_id}", so no collision exists today
either way, but the ordering is kept safe against one being added later).

schema.title: Response List Linkable Users Field Workers Linkable Users Get

get.description:
RF25 — an OCCASIONAL point past its event's valid_until is hidden here by default (no
archived_at column: computed at query time, spec Ruling 1). include_archived=true is what
the historical-reports view (RF43, later etapa) will pass.

schema.title: Response List Service Points Service Points Get

post.description:
RF16-RF17 — the field worker signals they cannot execute this stop (scope=STOP) or the
rest of the route (scope=ROUTE_REMAINDER). The report is the record; no audit-trail entry
is appended here (nothing on the assignment chain moved yet).

get.description:
The manager's queue. Only the PENDING queue is served — the impediment domain keeps no
other list — so any other `?status=` value is a client error, not an empty list.

post.description:
RF18-RF21 — move the impediment's affected stop(s) onto `field_worker_id`'s route for
the same date and mark the impediment RESOLVED. `reassign_impediment` delegates the move
to `reassign_stops`, which appends its own stop-assignment rows; this endpoint adds one
audit-trail entry naming the manager's decision.

Close the impediment with no reassignment (RF17) — a duplicate report, or one the
manager resolved off-system.

get.description:
RF41 — the coloured route board: every open route with its derived `is_delayed` flag and
OPEN alert count, the board's alert list, and the latest GPS fix per worker.

Server-Sent Events whenever its meaningful content changes (spec §2 Ruling 4, §4).

patch.description:
Toggle a rule on/off or override its threshold (RF50). An unknown `rule_kind` answers
404 (the path is a free string, not the path enum, so the check is ours to make).

post.description:
Mark one notification read. 404 when it does not exist, 403 when it is not the
caller's — a user can only touch their own centre.

RF46 — the same report rendered as a printable landscape-A4 PDF attachment.
RF46 — the same report as an XLSX workbook attachment.

AssignmentOut.title: AssignmentOut
AssignmentOut.description:
One row of a stop's append-only `stop_assignments` chain (spec §3.4, RF21). Shipped
in `assignment_history` only when the stop was reassigned at least once; the manager
panel (Task 8) renders it, the mobile app ignores the field.

ComplianceReportOut.title: ComplianceReportOut
ComplianceReportOut.description:
Mirror of `ComplianceReport`. The domain builder already returns frozen, JSON-serialisable
dataclasses; this thin `...Out` layer (built via `model_validate`, `from_attributes=True`)
keeps the API schema explicit and decoupled from the dataclass without restating the query
or re-deriving anything.

ComplianceRowOut.title: ComplianceRowOut
ComplianceRowOut.description:
Mirror of `ComplianceRow` — one granularity bucket with the 13 absolute indicators plus
the derived `completion_rate`.

ComplianceTotalsOut.title: ComplianceTotalsOut
ComplianceTotalsOut.description: Mirror of `ComplianceTotals` — the same shape as a row without the period identity.

EmbeddedForm.title: EmbeddedForm
EmbeddedForm.description:
The stop's active PUBLISHED execution form, shipped inside `GET /routes/me` so the app
has the schema (with hashes) before it goes offline (spec §5.2, Etapa 7).

ExecutionAssignmentOut.title: ExecutionAssignmentOut
ExecutionAssignmentOut.description:
One row of the stop's append-only assignment chain (RF21), surfaced on the execution
detail so the manager panel (Task 8) can show who was originally designated and why the
stop moved. Named distinctly from `app.api.route_view.AssignmentOut`: FastAPI dedupes
OpenAPI component schemas by class name, so two different classes sharing one name would
silently clobber each other in the contract (Task 5 hit this).

FilterAppliedOut.title: FilterAppliedOut
FilterAppliedOut.description:
Mirror of `app.domain.reports.compliance.FilterApplied` — the human-readable echo of the
filters that were applied, with UUIDs already resolved to names by the builder.

FormQuestionField.title: FormQuestionField
FormQuestionField.description:
One question of the embedded form, mirroring `FormQuestionOut`. `content_hash` is the
per-question fingerprint the app pins each answer to while offline (spec §5.2).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Liveness payload consumed by Docker healthchecks and by CI smoke steps.

LinkableUserOut.title: LinkableUserOut
LinkableUserOut.description:
Minimal projection for the dashboard /profissionais link-dropdown (Finding C2) — a
dedicated model instead of importing UserOut from app/api/users.py, so this router stays
self-contained per this repo's "no cross-router imports" convention.
